# truenas_kerberos_realm (Resource)

Manages a Kerberos realm on TrueNAS (kerberos.realm). Realms are normally populated automatically during an Active Directory domain join, but can also be managed directly — e.g. for a realm outside of any AD domain this system joins.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "truenas_kerberos_realm" "example" {
  realm = "EXAMPLE.COM"
  kdc   = ["kdc1.example.com", "kdc2.example.com"]

  # Left unset: admin_server and kpasswd_server fall back to DNS lookups.
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `realm` (String) Kerberos realm name. External to TrueNAS and case-sensitive; convention is upper-case (e.g. "EXAMPLE.COM"). Updatable in place.

### Optional

- `admin_server` (List of String) List of Kerberos admin servers for this realm. If empty (the default), the Kerberos libraries use DNS to look them up.
- `kdc` (List of String) List of Kerberos domain controllers for this realm. If empty (the default), the Kerberos libraries use DNS to look up KDCs.
- `kpasswd_server` (List of String) List of Kerberos kpasswd servers for this realm. If empty (the default), DNS is used to look them up if needed.
- `primary_kdc` (String) The master Kerberos domain controller for this realm, used as a fallback when TrueNAS cannot get credentials because of an invalid password (helpful in hub-and-spoke topologies). Null (the default) if unset.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the Kerberos realm.
